critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx: The heading uses flex flex-wrap per line — this is elegant, but on very narrow viewports the '&' can wrap to its own line. Not a bug, works fine at 390px.
Manifesto data-testid uses the string number '01/02/03' which matches spec — good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is a frontend-only marketing page. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL as base. Lenis smooth scroll is active; use scroll_into_view_if_needed or click nav anchors. All 4 regression fixes plus 10 test criteria pass.
